purpose: Document first-party local land/property registry or map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review.
assessment: Reviewed the Egyptian Survey Authority’s local branch directory (Asyut detailed-maps office) and public description of property-map/land-book responsibilities. Asyut University reports local GIS/survey field-training collaboration with the governorate Spatial Changes Unit, but this describes internal government mapping and data creation rather than an anonymous public parcel viewer. No public vector geometry route or parcel schema was exposed in the reviewed sources. No coordinate/owner-specific service was queried. Whether an authenticated or unpublished municipal/governorate parcel GIS covers the WUP locator; no point-specific parcel identity or map extent was verified.
